item.title: Ten Amtrak trains canceled in Midwest
item.description: CHICAGO — Amtrak has canceled several trains in the Midwest and Pacific Northwest today (Friday, Feb. 6), along with a second day of large-scale cancellations in the Northwest. item.title: MBTA introduces New Haven heritage unit
item.description: BOSTON — The Massachusetts Bay Transportation Authority has released its heritage locomotive honoring the New York, New Haven & Hartford Railroad. It is the second in a planned series of three locomotives honoring predecessor operators of commuter rail service in the MBTA service area. item.title: C&O No. 614’s restoration: A 2025 recap and 2026 resolution
item.description: STRASBURG, Pa. — A new year brings new resolutions. item.title: Nevada Northern No. 81 fired … again
item.description: ELY, Nev. — On the night of Feb. 3, the Nevada Northern Railway Museum successfully fired No. 81, a 1917 Baldwin Locomotive Works 2-8-0. item.title: In Memoriam: Robert (Bob) W. Brown
item.description: Bob Brown, Editor of Narrow Gauge & Short Line Gazette, passed away on Feb. 1, 2026. He was 93 years old. item.title: STB chairman updates status of pending proceedings
item.description: WASHINGTON — The Surface Transportation Board today released an update on the status of 13 pending proceedings, with Board Chairman Patrick Fuchs indicating decisions are expected this month in four of the matters, with draft decisions to be presented in three others. item.description: WILDWOOD, Alberta — The Transportation Safety Board of Canada is investigating the derailment of a Canadian National intermodal train west of Edmonton on Thursday.
